ThingDef.label: pillar arm
ThingDef.description: A slab of bone-cored meat, grown from monstrous tissue inside a Contagion amoeba. Fitted at the shoulder, it replaces the whole arm and hand with a club that hits harder than any hand. It is not matched to anyone, and cutting it out later has consequences.

ThingDef.label: lash
ThingDef.description: A pink rope of muscle, grown from monstrous tissue inside a Contagion amoeba. Fitted at the shoulder, it replaces the whole arm and hand with a fast striker that stuns. It is not matched to anyone, and cutting it out later has consequences.

ThingDef.label: eyeburst
ThingDef.description: A wet cluster of mismatched eyes, grown from monstrous tissue inside a Contagion amoeba. Fitted in an eye socket, it sees and aims better than an eye. It is not matched to anyone, and cutting it out later has consequences.

ThingDef.label: caudal spring
ThingDef.description: A coiled tail of gristle, grown from monstrous tissue inside a Contagion amoeba. Fitted in place of the spine, it grants a long daily leap and costs the owner a slower walk. It is not matched to anyone, and cutting it out later has consequences.

ThingDef.label: bellows
ThingDef.description: A translucent bladder with red fog inside it, grown from monstrous tissue inside a Contagion amoeba. Fitted in place of a lung, it breathes better and can blow out blinding smoke. It is not matched to anyone, and cutting it out later has consequences.
